c1_validation.evidence: 0 reference-category errors across 27 API calls with crypto.randomUUID() generated IDs. Model correctly extracted UUIDs from strategicContext.history and recentEvidence in every attempt.
c1_validation.pre_fix_behavior: Without valid IDs in repair prompt, model attempt-2 would generate a new incorrect UUID → CEO_PLAN_OUTPUT_RETRY_EXHAUSTED
c1_validation.post_fix_behavior: When attempt-1 fails with reference error, attempt-2 receives explicit list of valid history/evidence IDs → model selects correct UUID → validation passes

c3_status.evidence: 3/15 failures (20%) due to progression validation with accumulated history. Occurs with 5+ actions in history, especially when model attempts continuation of work already completed.
c3_status.mitigation_in_place: REPARACIÓN ESTRATÉGICA instructs model to use progression=new for clean restart, but model sometimes introduces continuation errors on different actions in attempt 2.
